## Changes Made

* Added Redux Toolkit for todo state management.
* Added Redux store configuration.
* Added todos slice for managing todo state.
* Added typed Redux hooks.
* Updated TodoForm to work with Redux.
* Updated TodoList to read todo data from Redux.
* Updated App component to use the Redux-based todo flow.
* Added/updated Redux Toolkit dependencies.

## Why This Change?

This change moves todo state management to Redux Toolkit to make the application's state handling more structured, predictable, and easier to maintain.
